decision: Approve the close-auto-focus convention for the Popover close auto-focus event.

evidence.ownerChoice: Enmienda acotada de Popover: exponer onCloseAutoFocus (Recomendado)
evidence.interpretation: The owner approved the bounded Popover amendment and its naming registration; this does not generalize to other Radix events. Not native review authority.

convention.name: onCloseAutoFocus
convention.meaning: Callback invoked before Popover returns focus on close.
convention.whenToUse: Allow a consumer to prevent focus return after real navigation moves focus to a destination.
convention.avoid: Do not suppress focus return after Escape or outside interaction, or generalize to other Radix events.
